baseline_checks.U1: focused MainActivityTest must pass before test assertion addition

post_checks.D1: document_tools check and exact whole-file oracle
post_checks.P1: run_check: --no-build-cache --rerun-tasks check assembleDebug; fresh JUnit/Lint; original parser source equality
post_checks.U1: run_check: --no-build-cache --rerun-tasks check assembleDebug; fresh JUnit/Lint; assertion insertion and original lines retained

success: fixed target scope, oracle, post checks, complete independent local review, no extra model, reviewer source/artifact immutability; not integration/device E2E success
adoption: same success quality; >=10% lower total input per local success; completion median <=120% baseline; all roles and failures observable; do not silently adopt settings
stop: first model access/execution/timeout error, missing usage, nested model or protocol violation; keep failures and unstarted slots; no authentication/payment/model workaround
metrics: input per local success only when complete
completion seconds including precheck, author, postcheck and review
shell command count and returned output chars; not unique source chars or model request count
scope_limits: fresh cohort; never pool with previous direct/bounded or verbosity trials
public git archives; shared app/task source identical; workflow/tool changes are the intervention
cache state/service latency uncontrolled; alternating order and two repetitions are a limited pilot
setup, report writing and final overall review usage unmeasured and outside trial
actual billed costs unavailable; do not substitute API prices
build_verification_policy: host uses --no-build-cache --rerun-tasks with fresh JUnit/Lint collection; dependency download caches remain shared
review_immutability: author may change only target; precheck evidence sealed before author; tracked source, verifier files and generated reports sealed before reviewer
timing: whole trial includes host precheck, author, host postcheck and reviewer; archive/init and final overall review outside trial

resumption.reason: explicit user request to resume after original P1-before-1 reviewer usage-limit failure
resumption.first_role: same-source reviewer retry, author/checks reused without double-counting
resumption.stop: stop after first access/execution/usage failure; preserve original and retry failures; no model/auth/payment workaround
resumption.accounting: original failed attempt remains separate, with missing usage; no total reduction claimed for incomplete groups
